name: sts_game_status
title: Downfall process and connection status
description: Inspect the configured test game process without launching, closing, or playing it. Works before a game connection exists. Reports stopped/running, scoped PID, runtime and next step.

name: sts_start_game
title: Start Downfall and connect
description: Start the verified copied Downfall game with bundled Java 8 and test online submission blocks, or reuse the same running test game. Only when the user requests game launch/play. Never rebuilds, edits saves, resumes a run, or makes choices. Waits briefly for MCP; starting means inspect state/status, not spawn again. Game stays open when MCP closes.

name: sts_get_state
title: Current game decision
description: Default decision view returns current-screen text and offered actions, including supported rest_controls, shop_controls, potion_controls, selection_controls and reward_navigation. Inspect target_playability and localized unplayable_reason before playing cards. displayed_cost_text is the final native rendered text; use cost_components for energy/reserves/reserve-only/X and Pyre sacrifice. Preserve completeness flags: unknown providers and unrendered cards stay incomplete. mechanics includes public character resources, spell/encode/flame panels and formation state; collection contents are paginated via section=collection or combat_collection (also nested in mechanics). panel_bindings_complete describes native panel access; information_complete and character_specific_complete propagate nested omissions. Before acquiring/upgrading a card inspect its upgrade_preview: next standard upgrade of this instance, after text/stats, changed fields and can_upgrade_after. unavailable is unknown, not unupgradable. For branching/tree choices inspect selection_controls.upgrade_choice and its selected_after before the separate confirmation. Event option_card_previews preserve shown cards. Standard previews do not predict event extra effects or on-obtain relic effects. Use view=map_plan for cheap position/plan polling: only IDs, map revision, route author, current/next planned node and ink count; no cards, full map, route list or ink points. Use decision view before acting. Full map/map_plan details are on demand via sts_get_context. Never infer actions from an unready state.

name: sts_act
title: Act and await next game decision
description: Apply ONE offered action using the observed session/state IDs, then return its receipt and next stable decision. No automatic retries or automatic multi-step gameplay. Potion discard is a separate destructive choice; never auto-discard to make space. Proceed may abandon unclaimed rewards: inspect reward_navigation first. Upgrade branch/tree selection and confirmation are separate actions. run.map.plan only draws a route: arguments must contain the offered map_id, revision and ordered nodes from map context (boss denotes the boss icon); empty nodes clears the route. It never moves the character. For event acknowledgement provide reading_id and meaningful commentary. Unknown/applied_waiting means inspect state and request; do not resend.

name: sts_get_context
title: Additional public game context
description: Read an on-demand public section for the same session/state: deck, map with node_id and children, map_plan with the full ordered planned route, piles, mechanics, collection, combat_collection (public contents with hidden draw order), history, screen, or full observation. At noncombat rest/event/grid decisions, deck includes next-standard-upgrade previews; screen includes offered card comparisons and any native upgrade confirmation alternatives. Preserve unavailable/incomplete flags; do not infer random event targets. Map planning uses drawn edges; special travel powers are not predicted. Never reads saves. Lists and both nested collection.cards in mechanics honor offset/limit; use each pile next_offset, or read collection/combat_collection independently. total is captured visible rows, count is native pile size, cards_complete concerns visibility, page_complete means this response includes the entire captured pile (not nested data completeness). These pages share the exact session/state snapshot; refresh IDs after stale rejection. Snapshot-level completeness flags remain unchanged across pages.

name: sts_get_request
title: Inspect action outcome without replay
description: Read a recent action receipt by request_id after timeout or disconnect. Missing receipt is unknown, not evidence of failure. Keeps the last 128 bridge receipts; never resends an action.
